Jesse Lewis Edwards Jr. (August 22, 1899 – death date unknown) was an American baseball second baseman and pitcher in the Negro leagues. He played with the Memphis Red Sox in 1923 and 1924, the Birmingham Black Barons in 1925, and the Nashville Elite Giants in 1929 and 1930.
